function.name: propose_wind
function.description: Proposes a wind for the drone, for the instructor to confirm. Nothing is applied. The code converts the units and checks the ranges.

from_direction.description: Where the wind blows FROM: a compass point (N, NE, north-east...) or degrees (225). Copy what the instructor said.

duration_s.description: How long the wind lasts, in seconds. Only if the instructor said it.

until_cancelled.description: true if the wind lasts until cancelled. Only if the instructor said it.

ramp_s.description: Seconds the wind takes to rise and to fall. Only if the instructor said it.

speed.description: The wind speed exactly as the instructor said it: digits or words ("19", "twenty", "12.5"). Never convert it.

unit.description: The unit the instructor used, as said. m/s if none was said.

function.name: propose_cancel_wind
function.description: Proposes removing the wind the instructor put, for the instructor to confirm.

function.name: not_an_order
function.description: The instructor's words are not a wind order.

ask.description: Only with ambiguous: one short question for the instructor.
